status: research-only; observer and action not implemented

schema_semantics.discovery: is_shown is evaluated with the potential host as root
schema_semantics.host_legality: can_plan is optional and falls back to can_start_showing_failures_only; can_start is the final start check
schema_semantics.continuation: is_valid is evaluated with activity root and activity/host scopes
schema_semantics.host_selection: eligible scores must exceed ACTIVITY_SCORE_THRESHOLD=20; the highest score becomes the candidate and its score is used as a percent chance
schema_semantics.location_selection: candidate provinces use weighted random ai_will_select_province; multi-location count uses ai_select_num_provinces
schema_semantics.cost: cost is the authoritative configured-resource cost; ui_predicted_cost is only a rough expected value
schema_semantics.outcome: on_start runs at creation and on_complete after the final phase; an AI-only completed activity persists at most one extra day

activity_feast.shape: single-location; province_filter=domicile_domain; AI province_filter=capital; holding required
activity_feast.host_gate_summary: landed or landless-administrative, above barony; no cooldown; available adult; continuation requires a living capable un-imprisoned eligible host and attendees once active
activity_feast.ai_gate_summary: after year three, no war, not focused on capital construction, sufficient short-term gold/treasury or override; county rulers normally require ai_sociability>=100; uncrowned AI blocked
activity_feast.ai_score_summary: base 30, -0.25*greed, +0.5*sociability, negative energy and trait/state modifiers; exact native/script result must remain authoritative
activity_feast.guest_summary: max 40; adult, healthy and in diplomatic range; host and guest intent lists default to reduce_stress_intent
activity_feast.cost_summary: resource can be gold, treasury, piety or barter according to exact government/house state; revenue-minister branch multiplies applicable base feast cost by 0.85
activity_feast.phase_summary: one predefined meal phase; host schedules progression after one month; completion dispatches conclusion/reward effects
activity_feast.why_first: base non-grand activity with one location and the smallest planning payload of the three frozen types

activity_hunt.shape: single-location; player domicile_realm and AI domicile_domain province filters
activity_hunt.host_gate_summary: above barony and playable; no cooldown; available adult; exact can_hunt_trigger; landless host requires three valid courtiers; nomad host must be landed
activity_hunt.ai_gate_summary: after year three, no war, not focused on capital construction, finance/warlike/nomad gates, county rulers normally require ai_boldness>=100; uncrowned AI blocked
activity_hunt.ai_score_summary: starts from zero and includes -10 base, county -20, -0.5*greed, +1*boldness, +0.5*sociability, negative energy and many type/trait modifiers
activity_hunt.guest_summary: max 20; adult or narrow nomad-child exception, capable, can_hunt_trigger and diplomatic range; join chance begins at 10 plus native modifiers
activity_hunt.cost_summary: gold, treasury, herd and other government-sensitive resource paths; dynamic scaling and hunt options make the payload larger than feast
activity_hunt.phase_summary: normal hunt phase advances after six weeks and schedules outcome events at days 21, 28 and 35
activity_hunt.deferral_reason: additional type/options and an opaque faith-dependent native gate; religion detail is deliberately excluded

activity_tour.shape: grand, realm-filtered, multi-location holder planner; up to ten pickable phases and one phase per province
activity_tour.host_gate_summary: landed above barony, DLC features tours_and_tournaments and advanced_activities, non-administrative; start requires duke+, age 12+, three vassals, five courtiers/guests and no civil war
activity_tour.ai_gate_summary: no war; uncrowned AI blocked; score base 30 with strong first-kingdom-tour and repeat/wealth/state modifiers
activity_tour.ai_score_summary: base 30; liege grand activity -1000; first kingdom-level tour +200; exact remaining branches remain script/native authoritative
activity_tour.guest_summary: max 100; host intent defaults to justice and guest intent to reduce_stress; join chance begins at 10 plus native modifiers
activity_tour.cost_summary: gold or treasury with era and option scaling; ui_predicted_cost averages options and is not commit-time cost
activity_tour.phase_summary: multi-stop route with multiple phase types and per-province weights/validity; completion cleans route-specific state and distributes results
activity_tour.deferral_reason: DLC gate, route selection, options and multi-location payload should reuse the proven feast host loop rather than lead it

candidate_row_observation.activity_type: opaque CActivityType pointer at +0x08; selected at 0x18E0952
candidate_row_observation.limit: identity/key layout and ownership are not decoded and raw pointers must never enter a public contract

selection_loop.rule: retain row with greatest signed score

percent_roll.rule: derive integer 1..100 and reject when roll >= selected score

native_ai_host_chain.boundary: This is an AI scheduler path. Its 60-month activity cadence is unsuitable as the player discovery query and must not be forced for player automation.

start.boundary: Class identity, size, clone, validation and dispatch are frozen; constructor field semantics, public-safe request construction and postcondition are not closed.

join.boundary: Character/activity identities and an opaque payload are visible structurally, but invite/open-activity discovery and full join reason semantics remain unknown.

ai_force_host_effect.non_ai_diagnostic: Trying to force non-AI character %s to host an activity %s
ai_force_host_effect.excluded: The executable diagnoses non-AI use. This effect is neither a player query nor the player start action seam.

observer_fields: valid location ids and native weights

next_observer_seam.why: It evaluates the played character's planner state without waiting for the AI's 60-month scheduler or submitting a command.
next_observer_seam.implementation_order: map HostView RTTI/vtable method to its final native evaluator, capture one normal read-only planner traversal, then expose a main-thread query with stable keys and copied values only

next_action_seam.target: CStartActivityCommand native payload validator and secondary dispatch
next_action_seam.requirements: construct a fresh exact-build payload from stable activity/location/option/invite/intent keys; validate at commit time; enqueue once; verify a new hosted activity owned by the same player and matching activity_feast
next_action_seam.prohibition: do not copy a captured 0x508 object, call AIAttemptToHostActivityEffect, force script effects, or treat command ACK as the postcondition

p0_slice.outcome_verification: after start, observe activity owner/type/state/current phase and terminal completion or invalidation; normal event windows remain governed by the existing generic event OODA
